AkkLove LAOS4-10 (X001003) – translation (Wasserman 2016)

Web: https://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/akklove/X001003/html

Project translation extracted from the ORACC HTML view (rank 3 in our hierarchy; consult only after our own reading).
Each paragraph: [first label – last label of the transliteration lines it translates] text. "## " = section heading.

[o 1] Let me be sated with your charms, Nanāya – your lips are very sw[eet...]
[o 2] [... your] passion is ... [...]
[o 3] [...] lovemaking, Nanāya, ... let us make love,
[o 4] [...] May I always be lustrous.
[o 5] [...] ... well-being, let him shepherd his men forever.
[o 6] [The...] ... (for?) Abī-Ešūh, may I perform again and again.
[o 7] [My lord], I will speak to her lover, so that she will gladly fill his heart with joy,
[o 8] [Muʾati], I will speak to her lover, so that she will gladly fill his heart with joy.
[o 9] [My lord], so sweet is your passion, the appeal of your love is sated with honey,
[o 10] Muʾati, so sweet is your passion, the appeal of your love is sated with honey.
[o 11] The image(s), the one(s) which you have looked (at), is/are constant festival(s). It/they will not be sat[ed...].
[o 12] Let me gaze at your body, so tall, filled with joy [...]
[o 13] Muʾati, (let me gaze at) your body, so tall, filled with joy [...]
[o 14] At you command may the king live forever! [At your command] may Abī-Ešūh live forever!
[o 15] The exuberant, our Muʾati, in daylight and darkness [...]
[o 16] (traces only)
[r 1'] (traces only)
[r 2'] [...] prime, good [...]
[r 3'] She looked on Babylon with her kind eyes [...]
[r 4'] She blessed it, she decreed its well-being [...]
[r 5'] Daily lif[e for] the king who dwells in s[ecurity ...]
[r 6'] Nanāya, life for the king Abī-E[šūh (will provide)...]
[r 7'] She let him dwell in security [...].
[r 8'] Passion, passion, (as) befits the face of ...
[r 9'] Nanāya of j[o]y.
[r 10'] She treats kindly elated Muʾati; she seated him on a large dais […]
[r 11'] Like dew charms (of love) rain down (on him).
[r 12'] [They make lov]e repeatedly. In her appearance he repeatedly rejoiced on her; whatever is hers is like water (for the) thirsty.
[r 13'] [Your ...] are beautiful. You are loveable...]. He is so sweet!
[r 14'] [...] this appeal of mine, rise, I want to make love (to you).
[r 15'] [...] let me be sated with your attractiveness.
[r 16'] [...] wherever, I will bring you whatever your [heart] desires from her.
[r 17'] [...] ... [...]
[r 18'] [...] let him be filled with love.
[r 19'] ...
[r 20'] ...
[r 21'] ...
[r 22'] [...] ... your(f.) love like a sleep [...]
[r 23'] [...] quickly [...] to veil [...]
